# Pinned copy of the PyYAML parser used by the workflow-syntax job
# of .github/workflows/cmake.yml. It is a fallback for runner images
# without an importable system-wide `yaml` module; the job prefers
# the image's own `python3` first. The sha256 digests come from
# https://pypi.org/project/PyYAML/#files and must be bumped together
# with the version, never on their own; Dependabot keeps this file
# current, like the commit-check pins. Only the manylinux wheels a
# GitHub-hosted `ubuntu` runner can select are listed: x86_64 for
# CPython 3.10 through 3.14 and aarch64 for CPython 3.12 through
# 3.14. Add hashes for a newer CPython before `ubuntu-latest`
# starts shipping it, otherwise the fallback fails visibly.
pyyaml==6.0.3 \
    --hash=sha256:9c7708761fccb9397fe64bbc0395abcae8c4bf7b0eac081e12b809bf47700d0b \
    --hash=sha256:b8bb0864c5a28024fac8a632c443c87c5aa6f215c0b126c449ae1a150412f31d \
    --hash=sha256:ba1cc08a7ccde2d2ec775841541641e4548226580ab850948cbfda66a1befcdc \
    --hash=sha256:0f29edc409a6392443abf94b9cf89ce99889a1dd5376d94316ae5145dfedd5d6 \
    --hash=sha256:c458b6d084f9b935061bc36216e8a69a7e293a2f1e68bf956dcd9e6cbcd143f5 \
    --hash=sha256:9149cad251584d5fb4981be1ecde53a1ca46c891a79788c0df828d2f166bda28 \
    --hash=sha256:ee2922902c45ae8ccada2c5b501ab86c36525b883eff4255313a253a3160861c \
